private const val MINUTE = 60
private const val HOUR = 3600
private const val ROWER_PACE_METRES = 500.0
private const val TOTAL_DECIMALS = 1
private const val LOGGED_DECIMALS = 2
private const val TEN = 10.0

/**
 * A cardio workout's numbers in its distance unit (`cardio-ui` R7, KAN-936 §8): km / mi, pace per km /
 * per mi, km/h / mph, m / ft — and a rower in metres, its pace per 500 m, whatever the unit.
 */
object CardioFormat {
    /** A logged distance, two decimals as L2 draws ("5.02 km"); a rower's in whole metres. */
    fun distance(
        distance: CardioDistance,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = metres(distance.value * distance.unit.metres, activity, units, LOGGED_DECIMALS)

    /** A plan's total, one decimal ("4.8 km"). */
    fun totalDistance(
        metres: Double,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = metres(metres, activity, units, TOTAL_DECIMALS)

    fun pace(
        seconds: Int,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = "${clock(seconds)} /" + if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) "500 m" else unitName(units)

    fun speed(
        value: Double,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = fixed(value, TOTAL_DECIMALS) + if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) " mph" else " km/h"

    fun elevation(
        value: Int,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = "$value " + if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) "ft" else "m"

    /** A step's length in words: `open`, `800 m`, `45 s` under a minute, else as [duration] reads it. */
    fun length(length: CardioLength): String =
        when (length) {
            CardioLength.Open -> {
                "open"
            }

            is CardioLength.Of -> {
                number(length.distance.value) + " " +
                    length.distance.unit.name
                        .lowercase()
            }

            is CardioLength.Time -> {
                if (length.seconds < MINUTE) "${length.seconds} s" else duration(length.seconds)
            }
        }

    /** A total time: whole minutes "32 min", else "2:40", and "1:05:30" from an hour up. */
    fun duration(seconds: Int): String =
        when {
            seconds % MINUTE == 0 -> "${seconds / MINUTE} min"
            seconds < HOUR -> clock(seconds)
            else -> hourClock(seconds)
        }

    /** Duration ÷ distance in the pace basis, to the second — only when [typed] is blank and both are known. */
    fun derivedPace(
        durationSeconds: Int?,
        distance: CardioDistance?,
        typed: Int?,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): Int? {
        if (typed != null || durationSeconds == null || distance == null || distance.value <= 0) return null
        val basis = if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) ROWER_PACE_METRES else units.metres
        return (durationSeconds / (distance.value * distance.unit.metres / basis)).roundToInt()
    }

    /** Distance ÷ duration in km/h or mph, one decimal — only when [typed] is blank and both are known. */
    fun derivedSpeed(
        durationSeconds: Int?,
        distance: CardioDistance?,
        typed: Double?,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): Double? {
        if (typed != null || durationSeconds == null || durationSeconds <= 0 || distance == null) return null
        val perHour = distance.value * distance.unit.metres / units.metres / durationSeconds * HOUR
        return (perHour * TEN).roundToLong() / TEN
    }
}

private fun metres(
    metres: Double,
    activity: CardioActivity,
    units: DistanceUnit,
    decimals: Int,
): String =
    if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) {
        "${metres.roundToLong()} m"
    } else {
        fixed(metres / units.metres, decimals) + " " + unitName(units)
    }

private fun unitName(units: DistanceUnit) = if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) "mi" else "km"

/** [value] to exactly [decimals] places. */
private fun fixed(
    value: Double,
    decimals: Int,
): String {
    val scaled = (value * TEN.pow(decimals)).roundToLong().toString().padStart(decimals + 1, '0')
    return scaled.dropLast(decimals) + "." + scaled.takeLast(decimals)
}

/**
 * The unit a target in [this] metric reads in, shared by the builder's rows and its step sheet; null for
 * incline and resistance, which each draw their own.
 */
internal fun CardioMetric.unitLabel(
    activity: CardioActivity,
    units: DistanceUnit,
): String? =
    when (this) {
        CardioMetric.PACE -> if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) "/500 m" else "/${units.name.lowercase()}"
        CardioMetric.SPEED -> if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) "mph" else "km/h"
        CardioMetric.HEART_RATE -> "bpm"
        CardioMetric.POWER -> "W"
        CardioMetric.CADENCE -> if (activity.isRide) "rpm" else "spm"
        CardioMetric.INCLINE, CardioMetric.RESISTANCE -> null
    }

import com.gymie.shared.cardio.shorthand.number
import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlin.math.roundToInt
import kotlin.math.roundToLong

private const val MINUTE = 60
private const val HOUR = 3600
private const val ROWER_PACE_METRES = 500.0
private const val TOTAL_DECIMALS = 1
private const val LOGGED_DECIMALS = 2
private const val TEN = 10.0

/**
 * A cardio workout's numbers in its distance unit (`cardio-ui` R7, KAN-936 §8): km / mi, pace per km /
 * per mi, km/h / mph, m / ft — and a rower in metres, its pace per 500 m, whatever the unit.
 */
object CardioFormat {
    /** A logged distance, two decimals as L2 draws ("5.02 km"); a rower's in whole metres. */
    fun distance(
        distance: CardioDistance,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = metres(distance.value * distance.unit.metres, activity, units, LOGGED_DECIMALS)

    /** A plan's total, one decimal ("4.8 km"). */
    fun totalDistance(
        metres: Double,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = metres(metres, activity, units, TOTAL_DECIMALS)

    fun pace(
        seconds: Int,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = "${clock(seconds)} /" + if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) "500 m" else unitName(units)

    fun speed(
        value: Double,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = fixed(value, TOTAL_DECIMALS) + if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) " mph" else " km/h"

    fun elevation(
        value: Int,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): String = "$value " + if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) "ft" else "m"

    /** A step's length in words: `open`, `800 m`, `45 s` under a minute, else as [duration] reads it. */
    fun length(length: CardioLength): String =
        when (length) {
            CardioLength.Open -> {
                "open"
            }

            is CardioLength.Of -> {
                number(length.distance.value) + " " +
                    length.distance.unit.name
                        .lowercase()
            }

            is CardioLength.Time -> {
                if (length.seconds < MINUTE) "${length.seconds} s" else duration(length.seconds)
            }
        }

    /** A total time: whole minutes "32 min", else "2:40", and "1:05:30" from an hour up. */
    fun duration(seconds: Int): String =
        when {
            seconds % MINUTE == 0 -> "${seconds / MINUTE} min"
            seconds < HOUR -> clock(seconds)
            else -> hourClock(seconds)
        }

    /** Duration ÷ distance in the pace basis, to the second — only when [typed] is blank and both are known. */
    fun derivedPace(
        durationSeconds: Int?,
        distance: CardioDistance?,
        typed: Int?,
        activity: CardioActivity,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): Int? {
        if (typed != null || durationSeconds == null || distance == null || distance.value <= 0) return null
        val basis = if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) ROWER_PACE_METRES else units.metres
        return (durationSeconds / (distance.value * distance.unit.metres / basis)).roundToInt()
    }

    /** Distance ÷ duration in km/h or mph, one decimal — only when [typed] is blank and both are known. */
    fun derivedSpeed(
        durationSeconds: Int?,
        distance: CardioDistance?,
        typed: Double?,
        units: DistanceUnit,
    ): Double? {
        if (typed != null || durationSeconds == null || durationSeconds <= 0 || distance == null) return null
        val perHour = distance.value * distance.unit.metres / units.metres / durationSeconds * HOUR
        return (perHour * TEN).roundToLong() / TEN
    }
}

private fun metres(
    metres: Double,
    activity: CardioActivity,
    units: DistanceUnit,
    decimals: Int,
): String =
    if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) {
        "${metres.roundToLong()} m"
    } else {
        fixed(metres / units.metres, decimals) + " " + unitName(units)
    }

private fun unitName(units: DistanceUnit) = if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) "mi" else "km"

/** [value] to exactly [decimals] places. */
private fun fixed(
    value: Double,
    decimals: Int,
): String {
    val scaled = (value * TEN.pow(decimals)).roundToLong().toString().padStart(decimals + 1, '0')
    return scaled.dropLast(decimals) + "." + scaled.takeLast(decimals)
}

/**
 * The unit a target in [this] metric reads in, shared by the builder's rows and its step sheet; null for
 * incline and resistance, which each draw their own.
 */
internal fun CardioMetric.unitLabel(
    activity: CardioActivity,
    units: DistanceUnit,
): String? =
    when (this) {
        CardioMetric.PACE -> if (activity == CardioActivity.ROWER) "/500 m" else "/${units.name.lowercase()}"
        CardioMetric.SPEED -> if (units == DistanceUnit.MI) "mph" else "km/h"
        CardioMetric.HEART_RATE -> "bpm"
        CardioMetric.POWER -> "W"
        CardioMetric.CADENCE -> if (activity.isRide) "rpm" else "spm"
        CardioMetric.INCLINE, CardioMetric.RESISTANCE -> null
    }
